text: You've heard octopuses have nine brains. Is that true?
Some of the weird facts are real. Three hearts. Blue blood.
And about five hundred million neurons. But only about a third are in its head.
Two thirds sit in its arms and body.
Each arm has its own big nerve cord. Its suckers can feel and taste.
So people started saying: one central brain, plus eight mini brains.
But in 2020, researchers put it to a test. Octopuses had to guide one arm through a maze to reach food.
They used their eyes and their central brain to steer the arm.
So the arms are clever, but they don't work alone.
As one researcher put it: one brain, and eight very clever arms.
Which octopus fact surprised you most?
